about: The fields of the Microsoft Store listing that do not change from version to version. The release workflow sends them with every Preview and Stable submission (scripts/store/Submit-Store.ps1), together with the description, short description and search terms from docs/STORE-LISTING.md, and What's new from CHANGELOG.md. Pictures, price, markets, visibility, category and age rating are not touched: they are kept from the last submission. When the website's own domain is ready, change privacyPolicy and websiteUrl to https://work.nexmio.com.

features: Pages as plain Markdown files in ordinary folders
A built-in version history of every change
Tasks, epics and a Focus view that shows one thing at a time
Plans with an outline and a map
Meetings with an agenda, notes, decisions and actions
An AI that runs on your own computer and only suggests
Works the same without any AI
No account, no telemetry, no ads
recommendedHardware: Windows 11 24H2 or later for the built-in AI
A neural processing unit (NPU) for faster built-in AI
